description: This file contains documentation for integrating the LiteLLM library with the jxnl instructor library to perform structured data extraction using Pydantic models. It includes usage examples for both synchronous and asynchronous operations, demonstrating how to instantiate the client, define data models, and extract user information from text.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing user data with 'name' and 'age' fields.

methods.name: extract_user
methods.description: Function that takes a text input and uses the instructor client to create a user object by calling the chat completion API with the specified model.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs the same extraction as 'extract_user' but using async/await syntax.
